task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the brain FLAIR MRI volume into the 3D Slicer workspace.
task_completion.visual_evidence: 3D Slicer interface showing a brain MRI with 'FLAIR' in the volume name or metadata.

task_completion.description: The agent uses a measurement tool (e.g., Markups line) to measure the width of the left Sylvian fissure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or ruler visible across the left Sylvian fissure in the axial or coronal slice view.

task_completion.description: The agent uses a measurement tool to measure the width of the right Sylvian fissure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or ruler visible across the right Sylvian fissure in the axial or coronal slice view.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the individual measurement markups to the specified JSON file paths.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Save dialogs or terminal output confirming the creation of 'left_sylvian.mrk.json' and 'right_sylvian.mrk.json' in the ~/Documents/SlicerData/BraTS/ directory.

task_completion.description: The agent creates the final JSON report containing all required fields: left_width_mm, right_width_mm, asymmetry_index_percent, classification, wider_side, and measurement_level.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal view showing 'sylvian_asymmetry_report.json' with the specific keys and calculated values.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI to perform measurements rather than just writing files via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with Slicer's 'Markups' module or ruler tools.

integrity.description: The measurements in the report correspond to the visual lines drawn on the MRI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The millimeter values shown in the Slicer 'Markups' table match the values written in the final JSON report.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo a pre-known result without opening the MRI file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The MRI volume is visibly loaded and manipulated (scrolling through slices) before the report is generated.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Sylvian Fissure Asymmetry Index (SFAI) is typically calculated as |Left - Right| / [(Left + Right) / 2] * 100 or a similar ratio; ensure the 'asymmetry_index_percent' in the report is mathematically consistent with the 'left_width_mm' and 'right_width_mm' values shown in the Slicer UI.
